page.title: Reservations cockpit
page.description: Track bookings, optimise capacity, and wow every guest from one unified view.
page.bookingLinkDescription: Share this link so clients can book a table online. They'll see availability and get a confirmation by email or WhatsApp when contact details are provided.
page.loadBoardError: Could not load the reservation board.

waitlistQueue.title: Waitlist queue
waitlistQueue.description: Offer status and manual promotion for guests waiting for a table
waitlistQueue.autoPromoDisabled: Automatic waitlist offers when a table frees up are not on your plan. You can still promote guests manually. Upgrade to enable auto-promotion.
waitlistQueue.autoPromoEnabled: Auto-promotion is on: when a reservation is cancelled, the next waitlisted guest may receive a timed table offer.
waitlistQueue.emptyDescription: Guests waiting for a table will appear here.

guestIntelligence.title: Guest intelligence
guestIntelligence.description: Repeat guests, loyalty moments, and smart follow-ups for your location.
guestIntelligence.emptyHint: Book more reservations to unlock repeat-guest and VIP insights.
guestIntelligence.confirmationsNote: Email and WhatsApp confirmations are sent automatically for confirmed seats when guests provide contact details. Configure your channels in Settings → Notifications.

portal.waitlistJoined: You are on the waitlist. We will contact you when a table opens.
